  Government
  [Photo of a person overlooking the Lincoln Memorial landscape in Washington D.C.]
  
  ### A world of capability in service of your communities
  
  As a global enterprise, we have a long-established understanding of federal, state, and local
  government needs. By drawing on our vast resources, technology platforms, and differentiated
  expertise, we create effective solutions for the most pressing challenges and provide unparalleled
  support for priority initiatives.

  Manufacturing
  ][118]
  Manufacturing
  [Photo of a technician sanding surface with 3M Xtract sander and personal protective equipment]
  
  ### Making the complex world of manufacturing run smoothly
  
  When it comes to fabricating, assembling or processing anything around the world, 3M knows
  efficiency is key. For you, for your team, and for your bottom line. From ultra-strong abrasives
  that keep processes running seamlessly, to futuristic materials that literally lighten your
  workload, and so much more, innovative 3M solutions help you create what’s next.
  * [Appliance][119]
  * [Bonding & Assembly][120]
  * [Converter Solutions][121]
  * [Defense][122]
  * [Industrial Machinery][123]
  * [Metalworking][124]
  * [Packaging, Shipping & Fulfillment][125]
  * [Paper & Print][126]
  * [Woodworking][127]

  Safety
  ][128]
  Safety
  [Photo of an industrial worker wearing 3M personal protective equipment]
  
  ### Advancing safe and sound through science
  
  We create safety solutions that help protect people and control their environments across
  industries. From personal protective equipment to infrastructure improvements, our technologies
  help ensure safety in a changing world and allow you to focus on your work with confidence.
  * [Facility Safety][129]
  * [Road Safety][130]
  * [Worker Health & Safety][131]
* [
  Transportation
  ][132]
  Transportation
  [Photo of a commercial airplane parked on an airport tarmac]
  
  ### Helping the world move safely and efficiently
  
  Our science is propelling the transportation industry forward with safer, faster, and lighter
  technologies across the seas, sky, and land. With solutions that can scale from cargo ships to
  scooters, we can help all manufacturers, transporters, and travelers achieve their goals.
  * [Aerospace][133]
  * [Commercial & Specialty Vehicles][134]
  * [Marine][135]
  * [Rail][136]
  * [Road Safety][137]
  * [Vehicle Registration][138]

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story
Celebrating 170 years
Life Unlimited
Sports Medicine
Ultimate victory

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

### **24/7**

#### **Support**

Always on: 24/7 multilingual Helpline and Emergency Assistance Services.

### **48hrs**

#### **Quick and efficient**

Fully completed medical claims processed within 48 hours.

## **Wellness Hubs**

At Allianz, we believe in empowering you to lead a life of balance and vitality. That's why we're
thrilled to introduce our Wellness Hubs; your go-to resource for comprehensive health and wellness
support. Whether you're looking to enhance your mental wellbeing, prioritise women's health, cancer
support, nutrition, improve sleep hygiene, manage weight effectively, or explore the secrets to
longevity, our hubs are designed to guide you every step of the way.

If you're interested in getting international health insurance for you and your family, we'd be

it suits you best.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Get answers to your questions quickly and easily with our handy FAQs.

[ Read the full FAQs ][131]

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## [About Us][25]

## [Hubei Baikang Medical Instrument Co.,Ltd][26]

BKAMED is a professional and leading manufacturer and exporter of first aid, medical, and healthcare
products based in China. With over 30 years of industry experience, we have established multiple
production bases across Huanggang, Wuhan, and Xiantao in Hubei Province, enabling us to serve
customers worldwide with efficiency and quality.

We specialize in a wide range of medical and healthcare solutions, including:
* First Aid Products (first aid kits, emergency supplies)
* Wound Care (gauze rolls, medical dressings, bandages, medical cotton, non-woven products, medical
  tapes)
* Sports and Home Healthcare (kinesiology tape, cohesive bandages, elastic adhesive bandages, pill
  boxes, hot & cold packs)
* Medical Instruments & Consumables (disposable syringes, catheters, surgical disposables, and other
  medical supplies)

As a dedicated OEM/ODM manufacturer of Gauze Rolls and Bandages, we have successfully exported our
products to over 60 countries and regions, including:
* Europe: United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Denmark, the Netherlands
* Southeast Asia: Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand
* Africa: Tanzania, Kenya, Mauritius, Angola, Libya, South Africa
* Oceania: Australia, New Zealand
* South America:Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, Brazil

Our partner channels include hospitals, supermarkets, pharmacies, emergency product suppliers, and
sports & healthcare retailers.

Milestones:
* In 2008, we established our first dedicated factory for first aid products.
* In 2021, we launched our own manufacturing facility specialized in kinesiology tape, self-adhesive
  bandages, and elastic adhesive bandages to meet growing customer demand.

Quality Assurance: At BKAMED, product quality is our top priority. We maintain a robust quality
management system backed by a professional QC team of hundreds of skilled personnel. We strictly
adhere to international standards, and our operations are certified under ISO 13485:2016. Many of
our products are also CE and FDA certified.

Why Choose BKAMED?
* 30+ years of manufacturing experience
* Certified quality and global compliance
* Competitive pricing & flexible OEM/ODM services
* Strong R&D and quality control capabilities
* Fast and reliable delivery to global markets

Our Commitment: BKAMED is committed to building long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships by
providing outstanding products, tailor-made solutions, and attentive service to our global
customers. We take pride in our reputation for professionalism, integrity, and efficiency.

Contact us today to explore collaboration opportunities and grow your business with a trusted and
experienced medical supply partner.

## [What We Do:][27]

Our products are supplied globally, including Europe, America, Australia, Iraq, Poland, the UK, and
Brazil. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships, we strive to
enhance competitiveness and achieve mutual growth with our clients and strategic partners. We
welcome businesses worldwide to connect with us for reliable medical supplies and seamless
collaboration. Visit our factory and join us in building a successful future together!

## [About Us][25]

## [Hubei Baikang Medical Instrument Co.,Ltd][26]

BKAMED is a professional and leading manufacturer and exporter of first aid, medical, and healthcare
products based in China. With over 30 years of industry experience, we have established multiple
production bases across Huanggang, Wuhan, and Xiantao in Hubei Province, enabling us to serve
customers worldwide with efficiency and quality.

We specialize in a wide range of medical and healthcare solutions, including:
* First Aid Products (first aid kits, emergency supplies)
* Wound Care (gauze rolls, medical dressings, bandages, medical cotton, non-woven products, medical
  tapes)
* Sports and Home Healthcare (kinesiology tape, cohesive bandages, elastic adhesive bandages, pill
  boxes, hot & cold packs)
* Medical Instruments & Consumables (disposable syringes, catheters, surgical disposables, and other
  medical supplies)

As a dedicated OEM/ODM manufacturer of Gauze Rolls and Bandages, we have successfully exported our
products to over 60 countries and regions, including:
* Europe: United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Denmark, the Netherlands
* Southeast Asia: Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand
* Africa: Tanzania, Kenya, Mauritius, Angola, Libya, South Africa
* Oceania: Australia, New Zealand
* South America:Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, Brazil

Our partner channels include hospitals, supermarkets, pharmacies, emergency product suppliers, and
sports & healthcare retailers.

Milestones:
* In 2008, we established our first dedicated factory for first aid products.
* In 2021, we launched our own manufacturing facility specialized in kinesiology tape, self-adhesive
  bandages, and elastic adhesive bandages to meet growing customer demand.

Quality Assurance: At BKAMED, product quality is our top priority. We maintain a robust quality
management system backed by a professional QC team of hundreds of skilled personnel. We strictly
adhere to international standards, and our operations are certified under ISO 13485:2016. Many of
our products are also CE and FDA certified.

Why Choose BKAMED?
* 30+ years of manufacturing experience
* Certified quality and global compliance
* Competitive pricing & flexible OEM/ODM services
* Strong R&D and quality control capabilities
* Fast and reliable delivery to global markets

Our Commitment: BKAMED is committed to building long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships by
providing outstanding products, tailor-made solutions, and attentive service to our global
customers. We take pride in our reputation for professionalism, integrity, and efficiency.

Contact us today to explore collaboration opportunities and grow your business with a trusted and
experienced medical supply partner.

## [What We Do:][27]

Our products are supplied globally, including Europe, America, Australia, Iraq, Poland, the UK, and
Brazil. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships, we strive to
enhance competitiveness and achieve mutual growth with our clients and strategic partners. We
welcome businesses worldwide to connect with us for reliable medical supplies and seamless
collaboration. Visit our factory and join us in building a successful future together!

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Competitive Intelligence with Discovery!

Features Of The Product
Find a company through technology
Comprehend natural language questions: automatically identify keywords in questions, sorting rules,
analysis and interpretation, industry comparison and other scenarios, AI generated results.
Learn more[arrow]
Quick access to technical intelligence
Generate technical analysis reports for the target company or technology area based on user roles in
one click, with interpretation texts that match the job characteristics.
Learn more[arrow]
Enterprise technology strength assessment
Analyze the strengths and weaknesses of companies' technological capabilities and competitive
advantages in specific technological fields through four perspectives: technological originality,
technological growth, technological influence, and international layout, and provide a basis for
judging competitive cooperation analysis.
Learn more[arrow]
Who We Serve?

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly
understand important technology trends, identify the competitive threats, uncover partnership
opportunities, and decide the direction of innovation.

### New Product Innovation Leader

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,
validate new ideas, and find the gaps in the market!

### Technology Research Analysts

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.
Why Discovery?
[Technology Intelligence Data Foundation]

### Technology Intelligence Data Foundation

Discovery brings company, patent, literature, investment, M&A, news, and research funding together
in one platform. Powered by AI and machine learning, the platform is continually updated with the
latest global data points.These connected insights provide a meaningful foundation for you to
analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.
[Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators]

### Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators

With our technology classification and ranking system, we help you quickly understand a company's
R&D strategy through patent portfolio and technology roadmap visualizations. This data empowers you
to measure a company’s innovation capability, technical influence, innovation originality, scale,
and stability.
[AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar]

### AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar

With our 24/7, AI-powered data processing pipeline, we automate the competitor monitoring process so
you don’t miss important insights that could impact your innovation strategy.

Dispotech is a leader among medical disposable products companies in Italy and worldwide. The
company was created by Massimo Mortarotti in 1994: after ten years working the chemical-medical
field in Milan, Mortarotti decided to create a new company dedicated to designing, manufacturing and
supplying of medical disposable products. Dispotech was founded in Gordona, in the Valchiavenna area
in Italy. Today Dispotech is recognised both in Italy and abroad as one of the leading companies in
the production of medical disposable products for various sectors: medical, dental, sports,

## Summer, sport and accidents: what are the most common injuries, and how should they be treated?

With the arrival of **summer**, there is an increase in outdoor activities, sporting events, summer
camps, excursions and active holidays. 

Whilst physical activity is an important factor in physical and mental well-being, it also increases
the risk of injuries associated with sport and leisure activities.

Sprains, bruises, swelling and muscle injuries are among the most common complaints during the
warmer months of the year. 

Added to this is the **weather factor**: high temperatures can increase physical fatigue, reduce the
ability to concentrate and increase the likelihood of accidents and injuries. 

Recent studies have shown that extreme heat is linked to an increase in visits to A&E for various
acute conditions, including certain types of injury.

This is why **first aid in sport** plays a vital role in ensuring a prompt response in the minutes
immediately following an injury, helping to minimise the consequences thereof and promote faster
recovery.

## Digital Health in Italy: how is the relationship between citizens, technology and healthcare
## services changing?

**Digital transformation** is radically reshaping the way in which citizens access information,
services and healthcare pathways. 

The healthcare sector is also undergoing a period of change that involves not only the introduction
of new technologies, but above all a shift in people’s expectations and behaviour.

Nowadays, patients are increasingly well-informed, connected and accustomed to managing many aspects
of their daily lives online. 

Searching for health information, booking specialist appointments, viewing medical reports and
contacting healthcare professionals are increasingly being done via digital tools. 

In this context, digital health is no longer a future prospect, but an **established reality**.

This is confirmed by data from **Statista Market Insights**, which suggests that the digital health
market in Italy is set to reach a value of around $4.48 billion by 2030, continuing a growth
trajectory that began years ago *(Source: Statista Market Insights)*.

[ Read the article ][61]
[22 6] Sport
22 June 2026

## Instant ice: the rush to stock up for the sporting and tourist season in June

With the arrival of summer, **instant ice** is once again one of the most sought-after products in
the medical, sports and first-aid sectors.

**June** marks the start of a period characterised by a sharp increase in outdoor activities,
tourist numbers and sporting events, leading to a rise in demand for quick and effective solutions
for treating injuries, bruises and minor accidents.

For distributors and retailers, this is a crucial time to plan stock levels effectively and avoid
stock shortages during the months of peak demand.

[ Read the article ][62]
[8 6 (1)] Medical line
08 June 2026

## Efficiency and hygiene: how Dispo ROLL and Dispo BAND optimise workflow in physiotherapy centres

In the hospital and outpatient sector, operational efficiency, patient comfort and hygiene
management are becoming increasingly central to day-to-day operations.

Particularly during the summer months, rising temperatures make it even more important to use
single-use devices designed to ensure convenience, durability and a better patient experience.

Everyday products such as medical sheets and single-use devices used in blood pressure measurement
are not merely consumables, but tools that have a direct impact on the quality of care, the speed of
patient turnover and the optimisation of operational times.

In this context, solutions such as **Dispo ROLL** and **Dispo BAND** support clinics, medical
practices, physiotherapy centres and pharmacies in managing high-turnover operations, helping to
improve efficiency and hygiene standards.

[ Read the article ][63]
[052026 D (2)] Medical line
18 May 2026

## Risk management in the medical disposables sector: why the quality of the material prevents
## hidden costs

In the medical disposables sector, the economic evaluation of single-use medical devices is often
based on a unit-price approach. 

However, this approach risks being misleading unless it is accompanied by a broader analysis that
takes into account quality, reliability and operational impact.

A single-use device that appears to be cheaper may in fact generate significant indirect costs
throughout the supply chain, affecting patient safety, the efficiency of healthcare facilities and
the profitability of the distributor. 

In this context, **risk management** becomes a key factor in the selection of medical supplies.

[ Read the article ][64]
[052026 D] Medical line
04 May 2026

## Instant ice: why B2B demand surges in May and how to pre-empt peaks in demand

In the medical and sports equipment market, seasonality is a factor that is often underestimated but
has a significant impact on stock management. 

One of the products most prone to spikes in demand are **single-use instant ice packs**, an
essential item for providing immediate relief from injuries in sporting, outpatient and
pharmaceutical settings.

With the arrival of May, demand for cryotherapy supplies surges significantly every year, putting
distributors’ forecasting capabilities to the test.

Understanding the dynamics of this trend and adopting more structured procurement strategies is
therefore essential to prevent products going out of stock, leading to missed business
opportunities.

[ Read the article ][65]
[Aprile Primo Articolo (2)] International expansion
20 April 2026

## Why Dispotech’s “Made in Italy” supply chain represents a true competitive advantage for
## distributors

In the healthcare distribution sector, ensuring **continuity of supply** is as much a strategic
factor as offering a low price or having an extensive product range. 

Having the right products at the right time means ensuring reliability for customers and maintaining
a stable revenue stream.

In recent years, however, global supply chains have demonstrated increasing vulnerability. 

Delays in transport, geopolitical instability and congestion along trade routes have made it
increasingly difficult to rely on supplies from distant markets.

In this context, the production of disposable medical devices in Italy is emerging as a strategic
choice for distributors seeking to build a more robust and predictable supply chain. 

In fact, a short supply chain is more than just a logistical choice. It's a genuine competitive
advantage that impacts costs, margins and service quality.

[ Read the article ][66]
[6 Aprile (1)] Medical line
06 April 2026

## Beyond healthcare: how to diversify revenue with disposable devices by Dispotech

In the healthcare distribution sector, growth depends not only on increased volumes, but also on the
ability to access new markets. 

Expanding the catalogue with versatile products enables distributors to reach new customer segments.

In this context, partnering with a supplier of patented instant and disposable ice can represent a
strategic lever for broadening one’s reach. 

In fact, many **disposable devices** aren't intended exclusively for the traditional healthcare
sector, but are also used in sports, wellness and retail contexts.

For distributors, therefore, diversifying the product range isn't just a commercial opportunity:
it's a strategy for building a more stable and resilient business.

[ Read the article ][67]
[Preview 23 Marzo] Medical line
23 March 2026

## What role do disposable products play in the prevention of cross-contamination?

In a high-intensity professional environment, **disposable devices** cannot be considered a simple
commodity. They are, in every respect, **a risk management tool**.

Reducing the analysis solely to the purchase price therefore means overlooking a significant factor:
the cost of error. 

In the medical and dental sectors — as in all environments where hygiene and safety are fundamental
priorities — the quality of disposable products directly affects service continuity, the reliability
of protocols, and the economic sustainability of the workflow.

## Medical disposable products company


Dispotech is a leader among medical disposable products companies in Italy and worldwide. The
company was created by Massimo Mortarotti in 1994: after ten years working the chemical-medical
field in Milan, Mortarotti decided to create a new company dedicated to designing, manufacturing and
supplying of medical disposable products. Dispotech was founded in Gordona, in the Valchiavenna area
in Italy. Today Dispotech is recognised both in Italy and abroad as one of the leading companies in
the production of medical disposable products for various sectors: medical, dental, sports,
promotional and mass retail.

## Summer, sport and accidents: what are the most common injuries, and how should they be treated?

With the arrival of **summer**, there is an increase in outdoor activities, sporting events, summer
camps, excursions and active holidays. 

Whilst physical activity is an important factor in physical and mental well-being, it also increases
the risk of injuries associated with sport and leisure activities.

Sprains, bruises, swelling and muscle injuries are among the most common complaints during the
warmer months of the year. 

Added to this is the **weather factor**: high temperatures can increase physical fatigue, reduce the
ability to concentrate and increase the likelihood of accidents and injuries. 

Recent studies have shown that extreme heat is linked to an increase in visits to A&E for various
acute conditions, including certain types of injury.

This is why **first aid in sport** plays a vital role in ensuring a prompt response in the minutes
immediately following an injury, helping to minimise the consequences thereof and promote faster
recovery.

## Digital Health in Italy: how is the relationship between citizens, technology and healthcare
## services changing?

**Digital transformation** is radically reshaping the way in which citizens access information,
services and healthcare pathways. 

The healthcare sector is also undergoing a period of change that involves not only the introduction
of new technologies, but above all a shift in people’s expectations and behaviour.

Nowadays, patients are increasingly well-informed, connected and accustomed to managing many aspects
of their daily lives online. 

Searching for health information, booking specialist appointments, viewing medical reports and
contacting healthcare professionals are increasingly being done via digital tools. 

In this context, digital health is no longer a future prospect, but an **established reality**.

This is confirmed by data from **Statista Market Insights**, which suggests that the digital health
market in Italy is set to reach a value of around $4.48 billion by 2030, continuing a growth
trajectory that began years ago *(Source: Statista Market Insights)*.

## Instant ice: the rush to stock up for the sporting and tourist season in June

With the arrival of summer, **instant ice** is once again one of the most sought-after products in
the medical, sports and first-aid sectors.

**June** marks the start of a period characterised by a sharp increase in outdoor activities,
tourist numbers and sporting events, leading to a rise in demand for quick and effective solutions
for treating injuries, bruises and minor accidents.

For distributors and retailers, this is a crucial time to plan stock levels effectively and avoid
stock shortages during the months of peak demand.

## Efficiency and hygiene: how Dispo ROLL and Dispo BAND optimise workflow in physiotherapy centres

In the hospital and outpatient sector, operational efficiency, patient comfort and hygiene
management are becoming increasingly central to day-to-day operations.

Particularly during the summer months, rising temperatures make it even more important to use
single-use devices designed to ensure convenience, durability and a better patient experience.

Everyday products such as medical sheets and single-use devices used in blood pressure measurement
are not merely consumables, but tools that have a direct impact on the quality of care, the speed of
patient turnover and the optimisation of operational times.

In this context, solutions such as **Dispo ROLL** and **Dispo BAND** support clinics, medical
practices, physiotherapy centres and pharmacies in managing high-turnover operations, helping to
improve efficiency and hygiene standards.

## Risk management in the medical disposables sector: why the quality of the material prevents
## hidden costs

In the medical disposables sector, the economic evaluation of single-use medical devices is often
based on a unit-price approach. 

However, this approach risks being misleading unless it is accompanied by a broader analysis that
takes into account quality, reliability and operational impact.

A single-use device that appears to be cheaper may in fact generate significant indirect costs
throughout the supply chain, affecting patient safety, the efficiency of healthcare facilities and
the profitability of the distributor. 

In this context, **risk management** becomes a key factor in the selection of medical supplies.

[ Read the article ][64]

04 May 2026

## Instant ice: why B2B demand surges in May and how to pre-empt peaks in demand

In the medical and sports equipment market, seasonality is a factor that is often underestimated but
has a significant impact on stock management. 

One of the products most prone to spikes in demand are **single-use instant ice packs**, an
essential item for providing immediate relief from injuries in sporting, outpatient and
pharmaceutical settings.

With the arrival of May, demand for cryotherapy supplies surges significantly every year, putting
distributors’ forecasting capabilities to the test.

Understanding the dynamics of this trend and adopting more structured procurement strategies is
therefore essential to prevent products going out of stock, leading to missed business
opportunities.

## Why Dispotech’s “Made in Italy” supply chain represents a true competitive advantage for
## distributors

In the healthcare distribution sector, ensuring **continuity of supply** is as much a strategic
factor as offering a low price or having an extensive product range. 

Having the right products at the right time means ensuring reliability for customers and maintaining
a stable revenue stream.

In recent years, however, global supply chains have demonstrated increasing vulnerability. 

Delays in transport, geopolitical instability and congestion along trade routes have made it
increasingly difficult to rely on supplies from distant markets.

In this context, the production of disposable medical devices in Italy is emerging as a strategic
choice for distributors seeking to build a more robust and predictable supply chain. 

In fact, a short supply chain is more than just a logistical choice. It's a genuine competitive
advantage that impacts costs, margins and service quality.

## Beyond healthcare: how to diversify revenue with disposable devices by Dispotech

In the healthcare distribution sector, growth depends not only on increased volumes, but also on the
ability to access new markets. 

Expanding the catalogue with versatile products enables distributors to reach new customer segments.

In this context, partnering with a supplier of patented instant and disposable ice can represent a
strategic lever for broadening one’s reach. 

In fact, many **disposable devices** aren't intended exclusively for the traditional healthcare
sector, but are also used in sports, wellness and retail contexts.

For distributors, therefore, diversifying the product range isn't just a commercial opportunity:
it's a strategy for building a more stable and resilient business.

## What role do disposable products play in the prevention of cross-contamination?

In a high-intensity professional environment, **disposable devices** cannot be considered a simple
commodity. They are, in every respect, **a risk management tool**.

Reducing the analysis solely to the purchase price therefore means overlooking a significant factor:
the cost of error. 

In the medical and dental sectors — as in all environments where hygiene and safety are fundamental
priorities — the quality of disposable products directly affects service continuity, the reliability
of protocols, and the economic sustainability of the workflow.

##### International Famous Enterprise of Biopolymer

# **Welcome to eSUN – Committed to leading in differentiated polylactic acid fiber development**

#### eSUN's production of polylactic acid material, biodegradable polylactic acid fiber, and
#### non-woven fabrics has reached an industry-leading level.

And polylactic acid bicomponent fiber is the leading and characteristic product among them, it has
achieved large-scale production and sales in the development of polylactic acid single and
bicomponent fiber and differentiated products. The company undertook and completed the national key
research and development project – research and development of high-quality polylactic acid fiber,
built the PLA fiber production demonstration line and the project, “polylactic acid efficient
biosynthesis and fiber preparation and application technology” won the2023 China Textile industry
Federation First prize for technological progress.

[About us][38]
[Contact us][39]
[eSUN company and factory pictures]

### Biodegradable & Environmentalfriendly

PLA is a renewable and fully biodegradable polymer made from plant-based resources through advanced
biotechnology. Its sustainable production and ability to break down naturally make it an excellent
eco-friendly material choice.

### Natural, Skin-friendly & Anti-allergy

Derived from lactic acid, a natural substance found in the human body, PLA fibers have a pH close to
human skin. This gives them excellent compatibility, making them gentle, hypoallergenic, and safe
for use in various products.

### High Strength & Excellent Durability

PLA fibers boast a breaking strength of 3.2–4.9 cN/dtex, outperforming natural cotton. Their
dry-state stretchability is comparable to nylon and wool, with even better performance in wet
conditions, ensuring durability and flexibility in diverse applications.

##### International Famous Enterprise of Biopolymer

# **Welcome to eSUN – Committed to leading in differentiated polylactic acid fiber development**

#### eSUN's production of polylactic acid material, biodegradable polylactic acid fiber, and
#### non-woven fabrics has reached an industry-leading level.

And polylactic acid bicomponent fiber is the leading and characteristic product among them, it has
achieved large-scale production and sales in the development of polylactic acid single and
bicomponent fiber and differentiated products. The company undertook and completed the national key
research and development project – research and development of high-quality polylactic acid fiber,
built the PLA fiber production demonstration line and the project, “polylactic acid efficient
biosynthesis and fiber preparation and application technology” won the2023 China Textile industry
Federation First prize for technological progress.

[About us][38]
[Contact us][39]
[eSUN company and factory pictures]

### Biodegradable & Environmentalfriendly

PLA is a renewable and fully biodegradable polymer made from plant-based resources through advanced
biotechnology. Its sustainable production and ability to break down naturally make it an excellent
eco-friendly material choice.

### Natural, Skin-friendly & Anti-allergy

Derived from lactic acid, a natural substance found in the human body, PLA fibers have a pH close to
human skin. This gives them excellent compatibility, making them gentle, hypoallergenic, and safe
for use in various products.

### High Strength & Excellent Durability

PLA fibers boast a breaking strength of 3.2–4.9 cN/dtex, outperforming natural cotton. Their
dry-state stretchability is comparable to nylon and wool, with even better performance in wet
conditions, ensuring durability and flexibility in diverse applications.

### textiles

With biodegradability, antibacterial properties, and warmth retention, polylactic acid fibers are

### Packaging materials

Polylactic acid nonwoven fabric is widely used in food packaging bags, shopping bags, gift wraps,
and shoe box liners, offering eco-friendly solutions.

[Medical dressings and bandages made of PLA nonwoven fabric]

### Medical and sanitary products

Its antibacterial, breathable, and biodegradable properties make polylactic acid ideal for medical
and sanitary items, reducing environmental impact.

### filtering

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity

  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions

  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become

  Predictions

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

  move before it's made, not after the press release.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Welcome to hg

Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of medical consumables with
expertise in R&D, production, and sales. We are proud to have achieved ISO:13485 and ISO:9001
quality system certifications, reflecting our commitment to delivering high-quality products. Our
product range includes medical protection and medical dressings. For sales and consultation, please
feel free to reach out to us.

[Read More...][16]

## Why Choose Us

When it comes to medical consumables, choosing the right supplier is of utmost importance. You want
a supplier that not only produces high-quality products but also adheres to strict quality standards
and has the capability to meet your specific needs. This is where Chongqing Hongguan Medical
Equipment Co., Ltd. shines as a trusted and professional supplier of medical consumables.

What sets us apart from other suppliers in the industry? There are several reasons why you should
choose us as your medical consumables supplier.

First and foremost, Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is dedicated to quality. We have
obtained ISO:13485 and ISO:9001 quality system certification, which demonstrates our commitment to
maintaining high-quality standards in both our production processes and the products we deliver to
our customers. This means that when you choose us as your supplier, you can trust that you are
receiving products of the highest quality that meet the stringent requirements of the medical
industry.

In addition to our commitment to quality, we also possess R&D, production, and sales capabilities
all in one. This means that we are involved in every step of the process, from the initial research
and development of our products to the production and ultimately the sales and distribution. This
integrated approach allows us to maintain strict control over the entire process, ensuring that we
deliver top-notch products to our customers every time.

Furthermore, our product range is focused on medical protection and medical dressings. We understand
the critical role that these products play in the medical field, and we are dedicated to producing a
wide range of high-quality items that cater to the specific needs of healthcare professionals.
Whether you are looking for protective equipment such as face masks and gloves, or medical dressings
such as adhesive bandages or wound care products, we have you covered with a comprehensive selection
of products to choose from.

Another reason to choose Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. as your supplier is our
commitment to customer satisfaction. We understand that our customers have unique needs and
requirements, and we are dedicated to working closely with each customer to ensure that we meet and
exceed their expectations. From providing personalized support to accommodating specific product
requests, we go the extra mile to make sure that our customers are satisfied with their experience.

Additionally, we pride ourselves on our professionalism and reliability. When you choose us as your
supplier, you can trust that we will deliver your products on time and in perfect condition. We
understand the critical nature of medical consumables and we take our responsibility to our
customers very seriously.

In conclusion, there are numerous reasons why Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. should
be your go-to supplier for medical consumables. From our unwavering commitment to quality and
customer satisfaction to our diverse product range and integrated capabilities, we have everything
you need in a supplier and more. When you choose us, you can rest assured that you are partnering
with a trusted and experienced supplier that is dedicated to delivering nothing but the best.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

material. Solutions from Lenzing are as inventive as they are effective when it comes to caring for
our partners’ success, the needs of our planet, and the demands of everyday life. We’re glad you’re
here. Feel free to explore. And get in touch if you have any questions.

Initiative, we actively shape standards and practices across the fiber and textile industries.

## [about **company**][232]

**Shandong Minolta Fitness Equipment Co., Ltd. (MND Fitness),** established in 2014, is a
professional manufacturer specializing in the R&D, production, and global export of commercial
fitness equipment.

Headquartered in Ningjin, Shandong, China, MND Fitness integrates product design, intelligent
manufacturing, quality control, and global sales into a complete industrial system. Our product
range covers **cardio equipment, strength training machines, and full commercial gym solutions**,
widely used in commercial gyms, fitness chains, hotels, rehabilitation centers, and professional
training facilities.

With years of industry experience, we have built a strong manufacturing capability and strict
quality management system, ensuring every product meets international commercial standards in
**durability, biomechanics, and training performance**.

## [about **company**][232]

**Shandong Minolta Fitness Equipment Co., Ltd. (MND Fitness),** established in 2014, is a
professional manufacturer specializing in the R&D, production, and global export of commercial
fitness equipment.

Headquartered in Ningjin, Shandong, China, MND Fitness integrates product design, intelligent
manufacturing, quality control, and global sales into a complete industrial system. Our product
range covers **cardio equipment, strength training machines, and full commercial gym solutions**,
widely used in commercial gyms, fitness chains, hotels, rehabilitation centers, and professional
training facilities.

With years of industry experience, we have built a strong manufacturing capability and strict
quality management system, ensuring every product meets international commercial standards in
**durability, biomechanics, and training performance**.

Today, MND Fitness products are exported to more than **160 countries and regions worldwide**,
serving distributors, gym operators, and project contractors with long-term stable partnerships.

We are committed to the philosophy of **“Professional, Durable, Innovative”**, and dedicated to
providing high-quality, cost-effective, and sustainable fitness solutions for global customers.

* **Complete Product Portfolio**: Cardio, strength, and functional training equipment one-stop

# NON-WOVEN

## Business Areas

### Automotive

Our main objective is to satisfy the requirements of the automotive industry and design customized
solutions to improve the driving experience and the comfort of the car
[ Learn more > ][99]

### Medical

In a sector with a high level of demand, our non-fabrics for the medical branch offer high
protection against contaminating agents thanks to their resistance to sterilization
[ Learn more > ][100]

### Filtration

Our nonwovens are widely used in the filtration sector, where specific mechanical properties such as
resistance to high temperatures are required
[ Learn more > ][101]

### Agriculture

The main application of our non-woven fabrics for agriculture is the production of plantings pots
[ Learn more > ][102]

### Construction

We are experts in the manufacture of acoustic veil. For more than twenty years we have been
supplying products for application to partitioning panels and false steel ceilings
[ Learn more > ][103]

### Cosmetic

Our nonwovens are excellent for use in cosmetic products due to their softness and breathability, as
well as their touch in contact with the skin
[ Learn more > ][104]

### Specialities

Our main objective at Murtra Nonwovens is to manufacture the non-woven that our clients need. We
work joining forces and synergies to bring all kinds of projects to life
[ Learn more > ][105]

### Wood

At Murtra Nonwovens we manufacture materials for the supporting of wood and melamine. Our supports
are non-woven fabrics with high performance adhesive
[ Learn more > ][106]

## Business Areas

Automoción
Nuestro objetivo principal es satisfacer los requisitos de la industria automóvil y diseñar
soluciones personalizadas para mejorar la experiencia de la conducción y el confort del coche.
Hospitalario
En un sector con un gran nivel de exigencia, nuestros no tejidos para el ramo hospitalario ofrecen
una alta protección contra los agentes contaminantes gracias a su resistencia a la esterilización.
Filtración
Nuestros no tejidos son ampliamente utilizados en el sector de la filtración, donde se requieren
propiedades mecánicas específicas como la resistencia a altas temperaturas.
Agricultura
La aplicación principal de nuestros tejidos no tejidos para agricultura es la elaboración de

# NON-WOVEN

## Business Areas

### Automotive

Our main objective is to satisfy the requirements of the automotive industry and design customized
solutions to improve the driving experience and the comfort of the car
[ Learn more > ][99]

### Medical

In a sector with a high level of demand, our non-fabrics for the medical branch offer high
protection against contaminating agents thanks to their resistance to sterilization
[ Learn more > ][100]

### Filtration

Our nonwovens are widely used in the filtration sector, where specific mechanical properties such as
resistance to high temperatures are required
[ Learn more > ][101]

### Agriculture

The main application of our non-woven fabrics for agriculture is the production of plantings pots
[ Learn more > ][102]

### Construction

We are experts in the manufacture of acoustic veil. For more than twenty years we have been
supplying products for application to partitioning panels and false steel ceilings
[ Learn more > ][103]

### Cosmetic

Our nonwovens are excellent for use in cosmetic products due to their softness and breathability, as
well as their touch in contact with the skin
[ Learn more > ][104]

### Specialities

Our main objective at Murtra Nonwovens is to manufacture the non-woven that our clients need. We
work joining forces and synergies to bring all kinds of projects to life
[ Learn more > ][105]

### Wood

At Murtra Nonwovens we manufacture materials for the supporting of wood and melamine. Our supports
are non-woven fabrics with high performance adhesive
[ Learn more > ][106]

## Business Areas

Automoción
Nuestro objetivo principal es satisfacer los requisitos de la industria automóvil y diseñar
soluciones personalizadas para mejorar la experiencia de la conducción y el confort del coche.
Hospitalario
En un sector con un gran nivel de exigencia, nuestros no tejidos para el ramo hospitalario ofrecen
una alta protección contra los agentes contaminantes gracias a su resistencia a la esterilización.
Filtración
Nuestros no tejidos son ampliamente utilizados en el sector de la filtración, donde se requieren
propiedades mecánicas específicas como la resistencia a altas temperaturas.
Agricultura
La aplicación principal de nuestros tejidos no tejidos para agricultura es la elaboración de
planteles.
Construcción
Somos expertos en la fabricación de velo acústico. Desde hace más de veinte años proveemos productos
para su aplicación a paneles divisorios y en falsos techos de acero.
Cosmética
Nuestros no tejidos son excelentes para su uso en productos cosméticos por su suavidad y
transpirabilidad, además de su tacto en contacto con la piel.
Especialidades
Nuestro principal objetivo en Murtra Nonwovens es fabricar el no tejido que nuestros clientes
necesitan. Trabajamos uniendo fuerzas y sinergias para darle vida a todo tipo de proyectos.
Madera
En Murtra Nonwovens fabricamos materiales para el soportado de madera y melamina. Nuestros soportes
son tejidos no tejidos con adhesivo de altas prestaciones.

## Technologies

[001 Tefisa Tecnologies02][001 Tefisa Tecnologies02]

### Chemical Bonded

In this production process, a liquid binder is applied to the fibers in a directed way, to join them
and create a fabric that offers high resistance to temperature and elasticity, as well as multiple
finishes.
[ Learn more ][107]
[001 Tefisa Tecnologies01][001 Tefisa Tecnologies01]

### Spunlace

Also called Hydro-entangled or tangled thread technique. Use fine jets of high-pressure water to
weave the fibers together, creating soft, comfortable fabrics that are highly tensile.
[ Learn more ][108]
[New Project 2020 07 10t155433.041][New Project 2020 07 10t155433.041]

### Laminated Nonwovens

Technology based on the adhesion of a film to the non-woven. We get a resistant and multifunctional
nonwoven.
[ Learn more ][109]

## Company

**At Murtra Nonwovens (MNW) we manufacture non-woven fabrics and distribute them for use in multiple
sectors: automotive, medical, liquid filtration, construction and agriculture, among others.**

Our range of non-woven fabrics is wide and constantly evolving. That is why Murtra Nonwovens, with
its two production sites in Piera (Barcelona – Spain) and Ystad (Skåne län – Sweden) is one of the
leading companies in its sector.

Furthermore, at Murtra Nonwovens we have our own R&D department where new varieties of nonwovens are
designed, tested and developed. The function of this department is clear: to create exactly the
material that our customer needs.

Murtra Nonwovens is part of Murtra Group, a worldwide benchmark in the textile sector that operates
in 4 divisions: Industrial, Decoration, Non-Woven and Lab.

All our processes are designed in the most ecological way possible and trying to leave the least

### CERTIFICATIONS

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### How does Simplify handle my data?

We're internet users too and place a heavy emphasis and commitment to your privacy. First and

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### Insole Board

Fiberboard, also known as density board, is a wood-based board made of wood fiber or other
phytovegetarian fiber, with urea-formaldehyde resin or other applicable adhesives.
* Broad market

### Outsole

Vulcanized rubber was produced in the 1990s. The first breakthrough in the development of sole
materials was POe-polyester artificial rubber. Compared with leather, natural rubber is still a
major feature of sole materials even if it is of average quality.
* Broad market
